memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Generalised anxiety disorder.
Evidence: GAD-7 score 14 (moderate anxiety), TSH 2.1 mIU/L (ref 0.4-4.0), haemoglobin 12.8 g/dL (ref 12.0-15.5).
Symptoms and examination: reports persistent worry, restlessness, fatigue, muscle tension; appears tense but cooperative, vital signs normal, lungs clear to auscultation.
Smoking status: former smoker, pack-years 20, stopped 2008.
Spirometry: FEV1 2.20 L (78% predicted), FVC 2.80 L, FEV1/FVC 0.79; change since prior N/A.
Inhaler technique: not applicable.
Assessment: Anxiety moderate; lungs stable.
Plan: start escitalopram 5 mg OD, buspirone 5 mg BD; repeat labs in 3 months; review in 2 months.

escitalopram 5 mg OD

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Generalised anxiety disorder.
Evidence: GAD-7 score 9 (mild anxiety), TSH 1.9 mIU/L, haemoglobin 13.0 g/dL.
Symptoms and examination: reports reduced worry, better sleep, occasional mild tension; appears relaxed, lungs clear.
Smoking status: former smoker, pack-years 20, stopped 2008.
Spirometry: FEV1 1.80 L (55% predicted), FVC 2.40 L, FEV1/FVC 0.75; change since last -0.40 L.
Inhaler technique: Technique checked: correct (salbutamol metered-dose inhaler).
Assessment: Anxiety improved; mild COPD evident.
Plan: continue current anxiolytics; add salbutamol MDI 2 puffs QID PRN for dyspnoea; review in 3 months.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Generalised anxiety disorder.
Evidence: GAD-7 score 16 (moderate-severe anxiety), TSH 2.0 mIU/L, haemoglobin 12.9 g/dL.
Symptoms and examination: describes increased worry, nocturnal awakenings, mild dyspnoea on exertion; appears anxious, lungs clear with mild wheeze at bases.
Smoking status: former smoker, pack-years 20, stopped 2008.
Spirometry: FEV1 1.78 L (54% predicted), FVC 2.38 L, FEV1/FVC 0.75; change since last -0.02 L.
Inhaler technique: Technique checked: correct (salbutamol MDI).
Assessment: Anxiety worsened; COPD stable.
Plan: increase escitalopram to 10 mg OD; continue buspirone; continue salbutamol PRN; review in 1 month.

escitalopram 10 mg OD

salbutamol metered-dose inhaler 2 puffs QID PRN
